title: Parler comme les Français
author: Christine Poquet
description: Learn French with MOI !This is a course on pronunciation and comprehension with a 26 episode-course and over 30 tests for pronunciation, accentuation, rhythm and a lot of comprehension episodes A and B level .Listen, learn and send your recordings to my email and I will reply and correct your pronunciation!Thank you for your support! A bientôt Christine
